protocol.model: Published PointPillars Car, full fine-tune with frozen BN running stats; common KITTI initialization
protocol.purpose: Six-epoch screening experiment, not convergence study; five retrospective outer locations, two positive validation locations each
protocol.optimizer: AdamW lr1e-4 weight decay .01 cosine to1e-6; batch1; clip10; BF16; seed23
protocol.selection: Best TRAINED checkpoint at epochs2/4/6 by equal mean validation-location exact 3D AP50, then AP25. Each location includes common negative-only validation groups. Report selected and epoch6 separately. Also report the pretrained control and a validation gate that retains it unless fine-tuning strictly improves validation.
protocol.augmentation: Source TRAIN donor crops only, >=10 returns, max3000. Uniform annotation-ID sampling; 75% frames attempt1-3 copy/pastes. Rigid yaw, uniform scale.9-1.1, x8..145, absY3..32, local q10 ground with TRAIN fallback and bounded -1.5..3m; reject vehicle XY collisions with .4m clearance. Remove scene points inside new boxes. Range-squared thinning and 50% half-space partial visibility. Global Z translation +/-1m. This is point-level augmentation, not new physical raycasts or paired RGB.
protocol.common_processing: Previous global XY/scale/flip/point-drop augmentation; same transforms per frame seed across paired arms. Independent donor RNG. Common post-operation >=5-point training support filter. Same 160k point/32k train voxel limits, anchors/loss, zero intensity, original railway geometry and full exact-quaternion test labels. Fold TRAIN-only trackbed normalization; real TRAIN point statistics provide common real-test normalization for both sources.
protocol.evaluation: All20 runs frozen before any new outer tests. Test frames cover all400 once per arm/policy; macro five-location AP primary, pooled out-of-fold AP secondary. No new blind data; no hyperparameter selection from outer tests. Source frame counts matched; box/physical-object counts differ.
